mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (title, content, writer, "date", product_id, file_name, file_type, file_data) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, COALESCE(#{date,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{productId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileData,jdbcType=BLOB,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.BlobTypeHandler})
mapper.select:
SELECT review_id, title, writer, "date", product_id, file_name, file_type FROM review
ORDER BY "date" DESC, review_id DESC OFFSET #{pager.startRowIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pager.rowsPerPage} ROWS ONLY
